product.name: uxui
product.lede: A plugin for Claude Code and Codex that improves a web UI in measured rounds and never merges it worse, usable today. And a UX search engine, specified, whose first search runs on a toy page.
product.meta: Agent plugin for Claude Code and Codex · ESS specification · Apache-2.0

sections.title: Here is exactly what exists.
sections.lede: Shipped means on main and usable today. Decided means designed and specified, with no code. Planned means a roadmap step that has not started.

sections.title: A loop you can run today. An engine on paper.
sections.lede: The plugin is the shipped part. The engine is a design and an ESS specification with no code behind it; the roadmap says what comes first.

items.title: Rounds with people
items.description: Trial, measure, triage, design decision, build and gate. At most five changes per round, so each metric movement can be attributed to a change.

items.title: Hard gates on every merge
items.description: No unwanted scroll, always-visible controls fully in view, an unmissable completion state, a screen-only user that completes every scenario, and 0 serious or critical axe-core violations.

items.title: Ratchets against a baseline
items.description: Lower-is-better values in a committed baseline.json. A merge that makes one worse fails; an improvement becomes the new baseline in the same merge.

items.title: Variants from the specification
items.description: The design space of an ess-ui/1 document, declared as axes: themes, templates, layouts, components, interactions and copy.

items.title: Evaluation without I/O
items.description: Every reachable UI state from fixtures, scripted events and a virtual clock, laid out by a deterministic model, scored by 47 declared metrics.

items.title: Watch the climb in the studio
items.description: The studio is an ess-ui/1 document, generated into an application that runs today on fixtures and scripted live events: watch a search climb, compare variants, promote one through ratchet. The search behind it is planned.

sections.title: Findings become tests. Values only get better.
sections.lede: The round loop runs with people at most twice a week; the fast loop runs Build and Gate on every merge, hermetic and without API keys.
